gcm.purpose: Universal Email Intake foundation using Cloudflare Email Routing and durable D1 staging.
changeNotes: Adds provider-independent inbound email receipt through the Worker email() handler.
Parses MIME with postal-mime and stages normalized evidence in email_intake.
Uses active intake-address validation and duplicate protection before D1 writes.
Does not use AI or Gmail API reads during email receipt.
